label: risky
summary: A production deployment workflow uses a mutable tag for a third-party action that receives a deployment secret.

findings.title: Third-party deployment action is not pinned to a commit SHA
findings.description: The workflow references example-org/deploy-to-cloud@v2 by a movable tag and passes it DEPLOY_TOKEN. If the tag or action source is compromised, the changed code could access the production credential.
findings.recommendation: Verify the action source and pin it to a reviewed full-length commit SHA. Rotate the deployment token if untrusted action code may already have run.

evidence.observation: The external action is referenced by mutable tag v2.
The action receives the DEPLOY_TOKEN secret.
